segments.en: Soldiers, one and all!!

I hereby take up the will
of my late father,

and swear to strive to build an ideal
nation for Gradosians and Earthlings alike!!

Roanne Demitrich,
come forward!
Sir!!

Soldiers,
allow me to introduce...

Roanne Demitrich, who will
henceforth be my right hand!

A Terran, and yet a truly
exceptional man!

From now on, I will employ anyone of
excellence without distinction, even
if they are not Gradosian!

For I have realized that only then can
an ideal nation truly be built!

Roanne Demitrich,
one step forward!
Sir!
Now, accept this!
Your Excellency...!!

It suits you,
Roanne Demitrich.

There you have it,
all of you!

This is the form
my ideals will take!

By the way,
Roanne Demitrich...

I hear that on Gaia, there is a belief
that fire purifies all things.
Yes, sir!

Soldiers!
Now is precisely that time!!

All that is old! All that is wicked
shall be purified and vanish!!

In accordance with Your Excellency's
wishes, preparations for the new
city plan are complete!!

Any who stand in the way
of my ideals...
prepare to die!!

rows.notes: Seg 12: Le Caine hands Roanne something unstated (uniform/insignia, seg 15 'it suits you') -- kept as 'this'. Seg 7: Le Caine calls Roanne [jp] -> 'man' (stated in the source; glossary gender blank). | [accuracy 2] project decision: grados-jin = Gradosian(s); chikyuu-jin (Le Caine's word) = Earthlings | [accuracy 8] grados-jin de nakutomo = not Gradosian (project term); 'Grados-born' narrowed it to birthplace

segments.en:
Everyone, you all heard
the Grados broadcast, right?

The one about Le Caine taking
full power in Gresco's place?

Says he's aiming to build an ideal nation
for Gradosians and Terrans! Give me a break!

The utter destruction of the old
culture... That's Le Caine's policy.

I bet the oppression will be
even worse than under Gresco.

Now that Gresco, the one who
held him in check, is gone...

Le Caine has set out on
the path of a dictator.

At this rate, Le Caine will
do whatever he pleases.

Chaos always comes with
a change of regime.

We must head for
Paradigm City at once!

W-Wait a minute!
What about Arthea?!

Yeah!
From that guy's place...

A huge Grados army is on the move.
I'm sure Arthea will show up there too.

Everyone!
Prepare to depart!
Roger!!

rows.notes: Seg 11: Ginga is cut off (meaning: rescue Hokuto's mother Vega from Arthea); left unfinished. | [accuracy 2] project decision: grados-jin = Gradosians | [accuracy 12] taigun = a huge army, not 'the main army' (added detail)

segments.en:
Hey!
Kanji!
Hello!
Um...

Have Hokuto and Ginga...
come by here?

Ah...
Those two...
GEAR HQ: Lounge
Nom nom nom!

Heeey!
Elise~!
Seconds!

Excuse me! I'm not your servant!
Serve yourself!

Hey! Hokuto!
Aren't you gonna eat?

Hm?
Oh...
I'm just not hungry...

We'll rescue her ourselves, okay?!
Your mom!
Huh...?

Straight up, I still don't
get what's going on.

But this is totally,
absolutely wrong!

Maybe she's that guy's sister
or whatever,

and maybe Galfa's in the right
or whatever!
But Ms. Vega's your mom.

And she got dragged off
like that...!

How can there be any peace in the
universe after that?! Screw that!
Ginga......

C'mon!
Hurry up and eat!

Sitting here crying isn't
gonna fix anything!

We can't even eat your
mom's stew like this!
Yeah...!

Even in this situation...
they're managing in their own way.
I see...

They're strong...
Hokuto and Ginga...
They've grown strong.

rows.notes: Seg 5: location caption. Seg 20: [jp] rendered 'Screw that!' (a general outburst, not aimed at Hokuto). Seg 24: 'like this' added to tie the stew line to the crying. | [proofread 5] location card format 'Place: Room' (matches dlg_4818_10306_01 r21 k5)

segments.en:
To correct your false memories, have
I no choice left but to borrow the
power of His Majesty...?
Whatever you do, it is in vain.

Neither I nor any of the people living
on this planet will ever bow
before Galfa!

INCOMING TRANSMISSION
FROM LORD LE CAINE.

Heh...! When they attack Paradigm,
that will be the perfect chance
to bury the Iron Gear!

I'll go and lend my full strength
to the assault on Paradigm!
Tell Le Caine that!!
UNDERSTOOD.

Is this what you call true peace,
Brother? Amid all this?
Hm?

And you say that this will
lead us, in time...
...to peaceful, tranquil days?

Tch...
Enough!
Take Vega away!

Keep a close watch on her until
the transfer to the home planet
is ready!
YES.

Brother... I believe in
the true strength that
people have within them...

rows.notes: UNKNOWN speaker talks in katakana (mechanical voice): rendered in capitals; same in row 24. [jp] = Galfa's home planet ('home planet').

segments.en: Any movement in Paradigm City?

I hear Lord Arthea will be
joining the operation this time.

With my father dead, Arthea
must be in a difficult position.

So, is he in league with
Pentagona after all?

Regrettably...
there is no doubt.

Heh... Well, no matter.
Summon Timp.

You called for me,
Lord Le Caine?

...That kind of job, is it?
So, who's the target?

Very well...
This mission seems
perfectly suited to you.

It has come to light that Commander
Arthea is secretly allied
with Pentagona!

Though he is allied with Grados,
such conduct can no longer
be overlooked.

Therefore, Commander Arthea
must be purged!
Well, well...

In short, he's to 'die in battle'
amid the confusion of the fighting.

Heh heh... It seems there's no need
to explain any further.
Leave it to me.

rows.notes: Seg 3/10: [jp] kept as 'Pentagona' (the Pentagona Continent side). Seg 11: Roanne says 'our alliance with Grados' -- JP [jp] = Galfa's alliance with Grados; 'our' read from Roanne as Grados's spokesperson; could be 'his alliance with Grados'. | [accuracy 11] referent: Roanne speaks for Grados, so 'our alliance with Grados' was wrong; it is Arthea (Galfa) who is allied with Grados

segments.en:
Wait!
From here, there's no turning back.

Are you fully prepared to
meet Le Caine head-on?

Not ready yet...
Take on Le Caine

There's no need to rush.
Prepare your forces thoroughly!
Very well!

At last the time has come to
settle things with Le Caine!

All hands!
Give it everything you've got!

Iron Gear!
Move out!!

rows.notes: Seg 2 is a choice page (one option per line): 'Not ready yet...' / 'Take on Le Caine' ([jp], final battle).

segments.en:
The enemy fleet has reached
the alert line.
So it's time...
Launch the fleet!
Lyle!
Sir!
Interception fleet, launch!

This is Paradigm City.
Enemy fleets are deployed
around the city.

Lord Le Caine! Can I go
all out this time?

Heh... Go and rampage
to your heart's content.
Hah! Then I'm off!!

So they've finally bared
their fangs... Foolish Terrans.

All of you who stand in the
way of my ideals! I will
destroy every last one of you!

Le Caine's definitely gonna
come at us for real this time...
Yeah...

Can you hear me,
Iron Gear?

Our fleet will hold the
enemy fleet in check.

Your ship should catch and repel
any enemies that push forward.
Got it!

Leave any enemies that
slip through to us!
I'm counting on you...!

All right!
Let's begin!!
Open the gun ports! Full salvo!
Nngh...!!

To think they're this strong...
The Neo Zeon fleet!
I must not underestimate them!!
Gwaaaaah!!

Wh-What firepower!!
Our army's weapons, beaten by
the likes of them!
Don't panic!!

Don't go wetting yourselves just 'cause
it's been a while since a fleet battle!!
B-But...

Hah haaa!
This is awesome~!
It gives me chills~!!

Hahahahahaha!!
Burn hotter!
Explode!!

Prepare for fleet engagement!! Treat
them as a regular army equal
to our own!!
Enemy mobile weapons incoming!

Lay down a barrage with the ships' guns!!
Intercept their vanguard with SPTs!!

rows.notes: Seg 25: [jp]/[jp] cut off mid-sentence (our weapons [being beaten] by them) -- kept elliptical. | [accuracy 25] elided verb restored: ...ni = (bested) by them; 'against them' read as our weapons being used on them | [editorial 30] 'Burn more! Blow up!!' read flat/awkward; same shouts, natural English | [editorial 33] 'the ship guns' -> idiomatic 'the ships' guns'

segments.en:
Anchor the Iron Gear!
We make our stand here!

This is the only road
a Land Ship can pass through.

If we deal with them one ship at
a time, we can take on a large army.
Roger!!
Enemy Land Ships approaching!
They're in engagement range!
Here they come!

So these are the Breakers
working with Grados...

Looks like they gathered
quite a lot of them...

But their morale
is not all that high.
Indeed...

Many of those Breakers must be
working with Grados half against
their will.

Deploying mobile units!
Let's go!
Yeah!!

Lord Le Caine, the first wave
of our ground forces has
been repelled.
The Iron Gear...

But it's nothing more than
localized resistance.
Keep pushing forward!

Colonel...... We have our hands full
with the enemy's aerial fleet.

Enemy land battleships are
breaking through below us.

In sheer numbers, Grados has
the overwhelming advantage...

Colonel! It's all right.
The Iron Gear will handle it.

True.
We'll leave the Land Ships
to them.
But... Colonel...

Amuro is there.
They won't lose so easily.
Yes, sir...
I'm counting on you... Amuro...
This feels like an all-out war.

Hasn't it been a while since we had
fleets slamming into each other?

You two! What half-asleep nonsense
are you spouting?!

Heh heh...! That Char fellow,
he's good!

Drawing the Grados vanguard inside his
own cage to beat it to a pulp, eh!

All right!
Let's go too!

Char...! Is that his idea
of trusting us?

rows.notes: Seg 16: [jp] aimed at Kanji and Kaine (segs 14-15) -> 'You two'. Seg 20: [jp] -- Amuro's wry doubt about Char's trust. | [editorial 16] 'What are you babbling about, half asleep' was clumsy; keeps the netaboke image

segments.en:
Hey! Geraba, if you want to make
a name for yourself, this is it!

I put you in a new model,
so don't screw it up!

I know, I know,
boss!

First time out in ages!
Let's go all out!

I'll show them what
happens when they make
me angry!!

Come on out!
Beck Victory Deluxe!

Deeh-hahahahahahaha!
I can't get enough of this!

I'll wipe you all out
without a trace!

rows.notes: Beck Victory Deluxe (Beck's machine) is not in the glossary -- romanized. [jp] -> 'boss'. | [editorial 1] 'letting you ride... do it right' stiff; Kid's bossy voice | [editorial 4] 'make them learn what happens' unidiomatic

segments.en: Eahhh-hahahaha!

My output's on a whole other level!
The OUTPUUUT!!
Damn it!!

I'll chop you to pieces with
my Laser-d Buzzsaw!!

And I'll pay you back plenty
for everything so far!!

rows.notes: Seg 3: [jp] -> 'Laser-d Buzzsaw' (glossary has [jp] 'Laser-d' and [jp] 'Laser Buzzsaw', Gosterro's Daljuan weapon); not itself in the glossary. | [editorial 1] bare 'The output!!' read oddly; stretched repeat mirrors shutsuryoku ga-a

segments.en:
No use, no use!
Shots like that are
never gonna hit!

What?!
You just won't go down!!
Timp, you bastard!

Was killing my dad and mom
on Grados's orders too?!

You think I take orders on
every little detail like that?!

I'm a lone-wolf Breaker,
through and through!

That's even more unforgivable!
You sewer rat!!

Hahahahahahaha!! Your pep
gets you this far and no farther!
Kiddo!

rows.notes: [editorial 1] shibutoi as a complete line (accuracy flag): trailing 'Stubborn little...' was not in the source | [editorial 6] 'Then I forgive you even less' awkward

segments.en:
Hahahaha!
Boss! This is a breeze!

Geraba...!
He's getting way too cocky!!

Ngh...!
This is bad! Retreat!!

Hey!
Wait! Horla!!

You're pulling back without covering
me when things are this damn hectic?!

Shut up! There's no way
we can keep advancing
like this!

If we fall back, there's enemies
there too!! All we can do is push forward!
I'm not sticking around for this!

Horla!
Get back here!!

Damn it!
What's that droopy-eyed
bastard thinking?!

Mr. Timp, you're asking
way too much there.

In a fight like this,
running away is how you win!

What did you say?!
You spineless coward!!

Let him go.
I'll give him a proper
thrashing later!!

Geraba?
What're you gonna do?

Hahaha... (sweat)
I'll, uh, humbly stay
right here, sir...

Good attitude. When a man
does something, he sees it
through to the end.
Is that Timp Sharon?
You seem to be struggling.
Hm, if it isn't Mr. Arthea!

As you can see.
Wish you'd come a bit sooner.

Our forces will now
enter the combat zone.

Guess I'll say thanks,
at least. This should
turn things around.

Good...!
Keep advancing as you are.

Once my fleet closes in from behind,
the Iron Gear will surely turn around!
Then you need only pursue it.
Understood!

rows.notes: Seg 9: [jp] proverb -> 'he who runs away wins'. Seg 18: [jp] -> 'Mr. Arthea' (Timp's mock-polite address), kept the same in rows 14 and 24. | [editorial 2] 'at a damn busy time like this' unnatural | [editorial 9] 'he who runs away wins' too formal for Geraba's slangy voice | [editorial 11] 'give him a good punishment' unidiomatic | [proofread 7] punctuation: question form needs '?'

segments.en:
The moment the Iron Gear turns around,
my ship'll charge in too!

Boys!
One more push!
Hang in there!!
You got it!!

I'm counting on you,
Timp!
Why, thanks...

Tch!
I just don't like
that guy!

That bastard Arthea... He timed
his arrival to when we were
struggling...

That talk about him
betraying Grados...
looks like there's something to it.

Brazen bastard! I'll slice him
up right along with
the Iron Gear!

Heh... First, let's see what
Arthea's made of.

New fleet detected west of
Paradigm City!! It's Arthea's fleet!

So it's finally shown up...
Arthea's fleet...!

All right! Hokuto!!
We're gonna save your mom!
Yeah!

Hold it! We're still
dealing with Timp!

Captain Elchi!
Can you hear me?

The enemy advance has slowed! The Neo
Zeon fleet alone should be able to
push back the enemy in front!

Iron Gear, head for
Arthea's fleet!!

We're in the middle of
dealing with Timp, you know?

I'm sending Nanai's fleet
your way.
This is the Musaka fleet!

We will now support the Iron Gear!
Leave mopping up the rest of
the enemy to us!!

Looks like we won't have to take
them on with just one ship.

Right!
Let's go hit Arthea!

Iron Gear!
Turn about, 180 degrees!
All right!

Hang on, Mom.
I'm coming to save you!

Boss Timp!
There's enemies closing
in from behind!

Whatever happens, full speed and
stick to the Iron Gear's ass!

That way, they'll have
a hard time shooting at us
from behind too!

Tch!
That's all we can do, huh?

Now then, will you give me
a chance, Mr. Arthea?

rows.notes: Seg 22: 1[jp] read as the Iron Gear no longer having to face both Timp and Arthea alone. Seg 27: [jp] -> 'Timp, boss!'. | [editorial 27] 'Timp, boss!' read oddly (accuracy flag); Timp no danna as one address | [editorial 31] punctuation: address split off the question

segments.en:
However many wars they live through,
humans never stop fighting...

How deeply this world has been
wounded because of such
foolish creatures...

Brother!
Please, stop this!

A battle like this is what's
truly meaningless!

Vega... your heart can be purified
at leisure once all is over.

To that end, I must first
crush them utterly!

This time, I will put
an end to everything!

All right! We came out on
the other side before the enemy!

We will now use the Iron Gear to
back up the Neo Zeon fleet from behind!

This is the moment of truth!
Put your backs into it!!

Target!
Arthea's fleet!

Timp's Deravace Galan is
at point-blank range!!

What?!
It came through the city?

Sorry!
We let several Land Ships
slip past us.

The enemy's too close to the Iron Gear
for us to get a clear shot!

We'll support you
with our MS squads!
Roger!

Hmph... That Timp,
he's good!
He's dragged us into a melee...!

rows.notes: [accuracy 1] tame ni here = because of, not 'for the sake of' (meaning reversed)

segments.en: Here I come!!

You've really sunk to being
a lackey of evil, haven't you?!
Mr. Plato!!

Oops!
Or were you always one?

Silence! You vulgar wretch
with no ideals!

Why can't you understand that a
privileged few hoarding all the gains
is what's unforgivable?!

To us regular folks, you guys're
the ones who look selfish!

Yeah, really. You blew this war up
however you liked... and we're the
ones stuck with the mess!!

Tons of people are dying
in this fight!
And still, you...!

It is unforgivable that sacrifices are
made to right this world's injustices...
but it is unavoidable!!

To realize our ideals, someone must
bear the sin and do what
must be done!!

Who cares about
your logic!!

What the Redros Army's doing is
no different from Giganos!!

Giganos's ideals are
my ideals as well!
I won't let you mock them!

Oh yeah?! Well, I'm never gonna
accept that you guys are
in the right!

Hmph!
How childish...

As long as you talk
like that, you'll never
beat me!!
What was that?!!

The lecture is over!
Here I come, Kaine!!
Enough of this farce, Dendoh!

All ships!
Battle stations!!

All right!
Guess we gotta do it
after all!
We won't lose!

Still struggling in vain,
even at this point!

rows.notes: Seg 18 onward: abrupt switch from Meio/Kaine to Arthea vs. Dendoh (separate battle exchanges in one row). Seg 19: [jp] -> 'All ships'. | [editorial 11] project term: Redros Army | [proofread 16] punctuation: question form needs '?'

segments.en:
Those wretches...
They're getting used to battle.

That bastard Arthea...
He's getting pushed back!

All riiight!
Keep going, get even
closer to the Iron Gear!

And what're we gonna do
once we're close?!

We ram our main gun
right up its ass!
You serious?!

Hurry up!
Our own asses are
on fire too!!
Fine, fine!!

rows.notes: [editorial 2] 'All righ~t!' odd stretch; matches 'All riiight!' used in _01

segments.en:
The enemy's first wave
is withdrawing to the rear.

New fleet confirmed!
It's moving our way!
The second wave...

We don't even get
time to rest...

They're still some distance off.
We'll resupply while we can.
This is the Musaka fleet!

An enemy Land Ship is
closing on the Iron Gear.
Watch out!

Wha-! When did it get
this close?!!

No way!
A suicide charge?!

All right!
Keep going and ram 'em!!

Yeahhh!
Here we gooo!!
Kyaaaaah!

What do you think
you're doing?!!

rows.notes: [editorial 9] 'Ram 'em just like this' awkward (kono mama tsukkome) | [proofread 7] punctuation: question form needs '?' | [proofread 12] punctuation: question form needs '?'

segments.en: Emergency!

Enemy troops are boarding from
their ship in large numbers!

Don't let them inside the ship!
Hand-to-hand crews, get ready
to intercept!!

Damn it!
Timp, you bastard!!
Do not panic!

We draw the enemy in,
then strike back!

Gather all who can fight
and set up a defense!!

Kanji!
You shall give the signal
to sally forth!
Roger!

Once you "Depart," a
hand-to-hand battle will begin.

rows.notes: Seg 9: [jp] -> 'Depart' (UI term), [jp] -> hand-to-hand battle. | [editorial 1] 'enemy troops... from the enemy ship' repetitive | [editorial 9] align with the matching system line in _01 r28 (quoted UI term "Depart")

segments.en: That's the signal!
Now, to battle!!

Nwahahahaha!
Kill 'em all!!

Mr. Gosterro, we're the ones
who'll be getting killed.

Look at that lineup!
They're nothing but monsters!

Lost your nerve?!
You coward!!
Are we really doing this?

Quit your yapping
and go!!
Eeeeeek!!
Wahahahaha!

Far too green to fight
the likes of us!
You're not up to it!

If you don't want to get hurt,
be gone with you!

Daaamn iiit~!
You'll pay for this~~~!

rows.notes: Seg 1: [jp] used in its common (inverted) sense 'not up to the task'.

segments.en:
THE IRON GEAR HAS STOPPED
ON THE BATTLEFIELD.

Heh heh heh...
Well done.

Advance!
Take position above
the Iron Gear!
ROGER.

Damn it!
They're right on top of us!!

No! At this rate,
we can't dodge it!

Like I'm gonna run
at a time like this!

Let's do it!
We're not giving up yet!
All right!

Come on!
Let's go!

I'll praise you for making me
struggle this much.
But this is the end!

That bastard...!
He's taking aim!
Our own guys are down there!!

Heh heh heh heh heh...
Just as I thought, he's
making his move.

Timp!
What are you doing?!
I'm aiming at Dendoh!

If we don't take that thing down,
Mr. Arthea's in danger, see.

Is this really the time
for that?!

Heh, sorry about this...
Mr. Arthea.

But we got our aim lined
up first, see!
Fire!!
What?!

Whoa...! Not bad,
Mr. Timp!

Kukukukukukukuku...
All sorts of things happen
on a battlefield...

When it's all over, this'll
be just a little mistake!
Mom!

Mom!
Mooom!

Hokuto!
We're going aboard!

We're gonna rescue
your mom!!
Yeah!
Vega...!
Ugh... I...

I lost any right to be called
that long ago...

Ah...!
Brother...
Don't tell me your memory...!

Hokuto! We gotta hurry,
this ship's in bad shape!

Ginga! Over there!!
It's Mom!!
Moooom!

Hokuto!
Ginga!
Mooooom!!
So you're Dendoh's pilots...
He... His mask!

rows.notes: Seg 15/17: Timp's mock-polite [jp] -> 'Mr. Arthea'. Seg 32: [jp] = right to be called 'Brother' (Vega's [jp]) -- kept as 'that'. Seg 40: [jp] number unmarked; plural since both boys are present. | [editorial 4] 'They've got the spot right above us' unidiomatic | [editorial 18] 'had our sights set first' incomplete idiom; target still unstated as in source | [editorial 33] 'Could it be, your memory!?' awkward; fragment kept (masaka kioku ga) | [proofread 13] punctuation: question form needs '?' | [proofread 14] consistency: 'Dendoh' takes no article everywhere else | [proofread 16] punctuation: question form needs '?' | [proofread 40] consistency: 'Dendoh' takes no article everywhere else

segments.en: Now, Hokuto, you can't let your guard down yet.
Not until we've driven off Le Caine's fleet.
I know.
Heh heh...
Let's go, Hokuto! Let's send Grados packing!
Yeah!!
I'm never forgiving them now! I mean, I never forgave them before either, but...
This time I'm REALLY never gonna forgive them! Grados, you dumb bastards!!
Amuro! Kanji!! We've rescued Ms. Vega!
I see. Good work.
And it looks like Dendoh came through all right, too.
Damn right it did! Like we'd ever let them beat us!
Ha ha!! You two are really something, you know that!
All right! Let's push them back in one go!!
Hokuto... Ginga... I'm counting on you! I'll go help the Iron Gear!

rows.notes: [accuracy 8] project decision: [jp] = 'Ms. Vega' (Hokuto)

segments.en: Sorry to keep you waiting!
Ms. Vega! What are you doing here?
Hokuto and Ginga rescued me.
So... where are those kids?
Dendoh's gone after the enemy fleet. Let's protect the Iron Gear!

<Win Condition>
Repel the enemy vehicles within the time limit.

rows.notes: [1]-[2] headerless [2] kept as George's reaction (follows his '...!!'). | [accuracy 2] project decision: [jp] = 'Ms. Vega' (George)

segments.en: Tch...! To hell with this!
Timp! The emergency repairs on the ship are done! We're pulling out!!
Much obliged. Right then, let's scram!!
Grrraaagh!! Someday, I swear I'll tear you bastards limb from limb!
Hmph, it's over. How goes the battle outside?!
The remnants of Arthea's fleet are withdrawing! The defense division is in pursuit!
Master Asia! We can still fight! Let's get back to the battlefield!
Very well! The Iron Gear will now advance on Le Caine's fleet!!

rows.notes: [2] [jp] read as Timp thanking Beck for the repairs ('Much obliged'). [6] [jp] -> 'Commander Undefeated of the East' (matches dlg_4012_09500_00). | [proofread 4] question mark restored: Master Asia is asking for a status report (style sheet '?!'); editorial flag

segments.en: We've made contact with the supply unit!
Once we've restocked our ammunition, the Iron Gear will sortie again!
Emergency repair crews, please start work on the hull.
Right. As soon as we're resupplied, we head for Le Caine's fleet.
We don't have much time, but let's prepare as best we can.
Yeah...
Once you "Depart," the fleet battle will begin.
Finish your preparations before you "Depart."
Iron Gear, move out!
Target: Le Caine's fleet!
Go! Funnels!!
With the Xi Gundam, I can pull this off!!
Waaaaaah!
Impressive...
Yes... We can't afford to make enemies of them yet.
I still don't have... that kind of power...!
Do I have to enhance my Newtype abilities even further...?!
Who cares about Newtypes! There's no point copying other people!
You're you, aren't you?!
We just have to do our own job and do it right!
I know that!
Here come more of them!
Lun...
Lun...
Can you... see us, I wonder?
If you can see us, then pray for us...
And... protect everyone!

rows.notes: [4] [jp]: Char on the Iron Gear's forces (ambiguous whether 'them' = the allies just seen fighting, which fits). [13]-[17] Kanji's prayer to Lun (absent); 'protect everyone' kept as a request to her.

segments.en: Ngh...
I won't let this stand!
Lord Le Caine! Please withdraw!
Our losses are far too heavy compared to the enemy's!!
We have the numbers, but at this rate our supplies won't hold out!!
I know that!!
But I will not let them do as they please any longer!
So you would stand in my way... Heh... What fools you are.
I will not lose to you apes!!
Commence the attack!!

rows.notes: [0] [jp] addressed to the enemy (Iron Gear forces); [1] [jp] -> 'apes'.

segments.en: It's too dangerous!! Please retreat!!
Have I... lost...? I...!!
That is not so. We can receive as many reinforcements from the homeland as we need.
Spare me your empty comfort!!
All forces... withdraw...!
Le Caine!! I'll let you go for now!
But I swear I'll come to take my sister back!
Heh heh heh... Bold words...!
But those words... I shall engrave them on my heart for now.
Farewell!!
The battle for Paradigm City had, for the time being, come to an end.
The allied forces of the Resistance and Neo Zeon won the battle,
and the Grados Army withdrew to the southern Gaia Continent.
After the Battle of Paradigm City, the fighting over Grados settled into a stalemate.
Le Caine had no choice but to wait for reinforcements from his homeland to regain his strength.
Meanwhile, Neo Zeon was also steadily building up its forces to prepare for the enemy's next offensive.
The Resistance entrusted the defense of Paradigm City to Neo Zeon
and moved its base of operations to GEAR headquarters.
Everyone knew the war with Grados was not over,
but people rejoiced at having been granted a time of peace, however brief.
And so... the Iron Gear was preparing for a new journey.
Its destination: the Pentagona Continent...
A land ruled by the mighty nation led by Oldna Poseidal.
I see... So many people suffered because of me...
Please don't trouble yourself over that. Right now, your recovery is what matters.
Mom... This man is your brother?
Yes... This is my brother, Arthea.
And you are...?
This is Hokuto... my son...
And you must be the other pilot of Dendoh.
Yeah...
So these children are the ones Dendoh chose...
Yes...
I see...
It must be a good world... this Terra...
Arthea...
Hm? You are... the warrior of Claudia, if I recall...
I'm Kanji Akatsuki.
We're about to set out for a new continent.
Before we go... would you tell us about Galfa?
I understand... I will tell you all that I have learned...
Brainwashed by Emperor Galfa, I became the Black Knight and was made captain of the Emperor's guard...
...so that I could use Ouga to seize the Data Weapons, along with Dendoh itself.
So? What's Galfa gonna do with Dendoh's Data Weapons?
What kind of power do the Data Weapons have, anyway...?
I mean, I figure they're incredibly powerful weapons, but...
What power lies hidden in the Data Weapons... even I do not know...
But Galfa feared...
...the legend that whoever obtains all the Data Weapons will rule the entire universe.
And Galfa wished to make that power its own...
But, Brother... there is something I cannot understand.
Why would a machine empire bent on wiping out humanity form an alliance with Grados?
Even if the alliance is a sham, I cannot see what Galfa stands to gain by forming it.
The alliance with Grados was no more than a stepping stone for invading Terra...
In the end, Galfa's goal is to swallow everything... and wipe out humanity... However...
Then a being called the Mediator appeared... and Emperor Galfa's will began to change...
What did you say? The Mediator?!
You know of it... warrior of Claudia?
The Mediator is an enemy we fought once before.
What is it? This Mediator thing?
That's the thing, we don't really know... It's like a mass of evil will.
There's a theory that it's a collection of wills trying to spread conflict between people... but nobody's sure...
Even the name "Mediator" was just given to it for convenience. We don't know what it really is...
That makes no sense at all.
Yeah... Galfa's easier to understand than that.
Ugh... You're right. If I'd known this would happen, I'd have listened to the Professor more...
No... what you said is true. A truly unfathomable evil will... That is the Mediator...
Under the influence of that will, Galfa has clearly changed its course...
And the Claudian who led it there is none other than Redros Binzvanker.
Oh, no... So then...
Yes... Galfa as it is now, together with Redros's cunning schemes, is scattering the sparks of war across the whole world.
What its final goal is, I do not know... but someone must stop it... *cough*!
Brother... you mustn't strain yourself yet.
Please, that's enough for today. Get some rest...
Defeat... Galfa! It is mighty, but you can...
*Cough*... *cough*... *cough*...!
Brother!
Oh, Ms. Vega. How's Arthea?
He's all right. He's asleep now.
Everyone, may I have a moment? Let's go over our goal once more.
When this war is over, if all of Terra... no... if this entire world isn't at peace, it will all have been for nothing!
And for that, all of Terra must first come together as one and fight.
Terra united as one...
Indeed!
If warriors gather from every continent, it can surely be achieved!
So that's the great purpose of our journey.
Exactly!
The Grados Army may have gone quiet, but the Gaia Continent is still under occupation.
Arthea and I will stay here and strengthen Asia's defenses.
Good. With that, we can set out with no worries left behind.
We've just received permission to dock at Theart Star, the gateway to Pentagona.
You can now dock there anytime.
As soon as you're ready, head for Theart Star without delay.
Understood.
Do you know the route?
Sure. I passed through there plenty of times back when I was a hauler.
Nobody could get lost going someplace that sticks out like that.
Well, that's true!
Well then, let's get ready to set out!
I see... So you're saying this frame is the cause, eh?
We don't know what triggers the resonance phenomenon.
We do know it resonates whenever a pillar of light appears, though.
Hmmm... Right! Let's take a look!
Oho? I see...
The space-time distortion is slight, but it can be measured...
Sure enough, with this thing, we might be able to put it to use.
But the problem is, there's no telling where you'd pop out.
Yes...
Hmm... So that's how it is...
Whoa! When did you get here?!
I came to bring you your dinner, Mr. Eji!
Oh! Right. Thanks, as always.
Never mind that, mister! Haven't you made anything more useful? Like a weapon for Dendoh?
You fool! As if I would ever build weapons for war!
But still...
Ginga, this research is important too.
You're getting in the way of my research! Both of you, out!
What a drag.
Well, good luck!
Hokuto's House
So it's finally time to go.
Hokuto... Ginga... do your best.
I can't quite take Ms. Vega's place, but... I'll support you as much as I can.
Ugh! You're coming too?!
What? Got a problem with that?
No. Without you, Elise, Dendoh couldn't fight properly. I'm counting on you, Elise.
Good answer!
I'm sorry... It's always you children who have to bear it...
It's okay, Mom. We'll be fine!
So don't worry.
Yeah! Galfa, Redros, whoever! I'll blow 'em all away!
Well, Mom, we're off!
Hokuto, Ginga... *sob*... *sob*...
Honey...!
Keisuke...
Honestly... You always try to carry everything on your own like that...
This isn't a fight you have to face alone anymore.
Keisuke... *sob*... *sob*...
Ginga... thanks, really.
Heh. If you wanna thank somebody, thank everyone on the Iron Gear.
...Yeah, you're right.
Hokuto, Ginga... We're all fighting this together. Of course we help each other out, right?
Kanji...
Let's all give it everything we've got!
Yeah!!
You're going, Spike...?
Yeah... This is as far as I can tag along.
Well, I make it a rule to do things my own way.
If I'm in the mood, I'll lean on you guys again sometime...
...Take care!
You too.
Hey! You there, with the old clunker!
What was that?!
You calling my Swordfish a clunker?!
What else would you call it? Ha ha ha ha ha!!
...If you don't want anything, get out of my way.
Now, now, don't get sore. I'm here about a job!
Huh?
Not many guys can fly a clunker like that... How'd you like to come work for me?
So? What's the pay?
Homemade bell peppers and beef.
Just so you know, I'm not eating it without the beef.
That depends on how hard you work.
Heh... Fine by me.
We're sure gonna miss Spike...
Yeah, no question, he's a fine pilot.
But still... why would he leave at a time like this...
Spike must have his own reasons. Don't worry... we'll see him again.
Kanji, Amuro, let's go!
Right...
All riiight! Let's head out!
Iron Gear, move out!!
